name: roof-above-real
notes: The roof-above machine on the REAL Nether roof of the official server's world (default Nether generation): the target is the real top-layer bedrock at (100, 127, 100), the machine sits on the roof at y 128+, and the bot stands ON the roof, crawling under a one-block ceiling beside the swap piston, its clicks checked against its real line of sight (legit). The machine is placed and driven by commands standing in for a build and a clock; the press (break + place a piston facing down) is the bot's real packets.
setup: execute in minecraft:the_nether run forceload add 96 96 104 104
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill 100 127 100 100 127 100 minecraft:bedrock
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill 99 128 100 100 128 100 minecraft:air

script.state: execute in minecraft:the_nether run forceload add 96 96 104 104
execute in minecraft:the_nether if block 100 127 100 minecraft:bedrock
execute in minecraft:the_nether run setblock 100 128 100 minecraft:piston[facing=west]
execute in minecraft:the_nether run setblock 101 131 100 minecraft:stone
execute in minecraft:the_nether run setblock 101 131 100 minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:the_nether run setblock 100 128 104 minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:the_nether run setblock 100 128 104 minecraft:redstone_block
